message: minimum-release-age=60 in .npmrc sets pnpm 10.20.0 to wait 1 hour, shorter than 3d in depgate.json, because pnpm-workspace.yaml does not set minimumReleaseAge
fix: Remove the line and run depgate apply, which writes the delay to pnpm-workspace.yaml

message: minimum-release-age-exclude[] in .npmrc exempts lodash from the pnpm 10.20.0 delay, but depgate.json does not
fix: Remove the line, or add lodash to cooldown.exclude in depgate.json and run depgate apply
